The '''P-20 seeker missile''' was a missile model used during the [[Galactic War]]. Powerful enough to bring down small starfighters, the forces of [[InterStellar Regulators]] founder [[The Warhound|Warhound]] used such missiles during the [[Conquest of Makeb]].<ref name="TOR" />
